# nexus pihole get

Get Pi-hole status

Returns one item, current: the Pi-hole core, web and FTL versions, the backend (v5-cli, or unsupported on Pi-hole v6), whether FTL is running and answers DNS on 127.0.0.1, the blocking state (enabled, disabled or unknown) with reenableAt, the time a pending Nexus re-enable turns it back on, and the gravity (blocklist) domain count and last update. A field Nexus cannot determine is null or unknown rather than an error. Read-only; runs no Pi-hole command. Fails capability-unavailable when the provider is unavailable.

## Usage

```
nexus pihole get [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # Get Pi-hole status
  nexus pihole get
```

## Flags

```
      --filter stringArray   key=value, repeatable: print only objects whose dot path has this value; a repeated key matches any of its values
  -h, --help                 help for get
  -o, --output string        output format: table, json, jsonl, yaml (default table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise)
      --select strings       print only these dot paths of each object, comma-separated, such as name,properties.state; host and id are always kept
      --tag strings          target every configured host with this tag; comma-separated or repeated for any of several
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```
